benefits.name: Hilton Honors Silver Status
benefits.description: Complimentary Hilton Honors Silver elite status, including a 20% bonus on base points earned and the fifth night free on standard room award stays booked with points.
benefits.terms: Automatic with card membership; no separate enrollment required beyond linking a Hilton Honors account.

benefits.name: Hilton Honors Gold Status via Spend
benefits.description: Upgrade to Hilton Honors Gold status after spending $20,000 in eligible purchases on the card in a calendar year.
benefits.terms: Requires $20,000 in eligible calendar-year spend on the card.

benefits.name: Car Rental Loss and Damage Insurance
benefits.description: Secondary coverage for damage or theft of most rental vehicles, up to $50,000 per rental agreement, for rentals up to 30 consecutive days.
benefits.terms: Secondary coverage (your personal auto insurance pays first). Excludes rentals in Australia, Italy, and New Zealand.

benefits.name: Purchase Protection
benefits.description: Covers eligible purchases against theft or accidental damage for 90 days, up to $1,000 per purchase and $50,000 per card member account per calendar year.

benefits.name: Extended Warranty Protection
benefits.description: Extends the original U.S. manufacturer's warranty by up to one additional year on eligible purchases.

earningRates.terms: Eligible purchases charged directly with a property within the Hilton portfolio.
U.S. restaurants (including takeout and delivery), U.S. supermarkets, and U.S. gas stations.
